dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Thank you for remembering my request, Master Tarno. I will be sure to treasure this pocket watch.

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: There's no need to stand on ceremony, Mr. Flins. If I may be so bold, I'd say this watch is fortunate to have ended up in the hands of someone as discerning as yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Hehe, even if that someone turned up to collect it half a month late because he needed more time to get the money?

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: I do hope it won't miss the finer life and flee back to your shop in the middle of the night...

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Hahahaha, such a wonderful sense of humor. Even if it wished to escape, I doubt it would get far with a Ratnik such as yourself on its tail. Here, I've already wrapped it — it's yours.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: My thanks again, Dear Master Tarno. Perhaps we can have a drink in The Flagship when you're next free.

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: It would be my pleasure, Mr. Flins.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Bought yourself a new shiny, then?

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: You could say so. This pocket watch cost me half a month's salary. I suppose that means no more fine liquor for me for the next two weeks.

choices.text: I'm sure I could treat you to a drink.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: #In that case, I should paraphrase Master Tarno just now and say, "My pleasure, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME}."

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: I look forward to your invitation.

choices.text: You can drink fruit juice with me.
